newsitem.title: UK: London shares end higher, seen testing record peak.
newsitem.headline: London shares end higher, seen testing record peak.

text.p: UK shares pushed back on Wednesday to within striking distance of their record closing levels as investors on both sides of the Atlantic celebrated the U.S. central bank's decision to leave U.S. interest rates at current levels.
The FTSE 100 index ended 34.5 points firmer to 4,642.0, only 51.9 points below its record closing high of 4,693.9, set on May 16.
"The bull is not dead yet," one senior dealer said. "We could a new record tomorrow as long as the Dow keeps going (higher)."
